description:
The Snowplow BigQuery Repeater attempted to process the following payload but was unable to insert it into the warehouse: `{"event":"click","user":"12345"}`. The insertion failed with the error message “Failed to insert payload due to service outage.” The target location was `bigquery://myproject.mydataset.events`, and the underlying reason was identified as a transient network issue.

This failure originated from the Snowplow component identified by the artifact `snowplow-bigquery-repeater`, version `1.0.0`.
